meta.description: Chapel Hill movers for student apartments, small loads and storage between terms, plus family moves across the Triangle. Hourly billing. Free quote.

overview: A Chapel Hill move is often small and on a deadline: a lease ending in May, a new one starting in August, and a few months of storage in between. We handle the whole stretch.
Family homes and moves elsewhere in the Triangle get the same Triangle crews.
hero.ctaLabel: Get a Chapel Hill Moving Quote

servicesBlock.intro: Students tend to need college moves, furniture-only jobs and storage, and families need full residential moves. Every service is listed below.

whyChoose.h2: Good Reasons to Book Us in Chapel Hill

cards.title: Built for Term Dates
cards.text: Give us your move-out and move-in dates together, and we plan the pickup, storage and delivery as one job.

cards.title: Two Hours Covers a Lot
cards.text: Our minimum is two hours, travel included, which suits a single room or a few pieces.

cards.title: Across the Triangle
cards.text: Moving from Chapel Hill to Durham, Cary or Raleigh? It's one local move with our Triangle crews.

cards.title: Real Carrier Paperwork
cards.text: We're federally registered under USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489, which matters when the next move crosses a state line.

faq.q: Do Chapel Hill movers take small student moves?
faq.a: Yes. A room or a studio is a normal job for us, billed under the 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

faq.q: Can you store my things in Chapel Hill over the summer?
faq.a: Yes. We pick up when your lease ends, store everything and deliver to your next address on the date you set.

faq.q: How much does a move within Chapel Hill cost?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, with blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) inside the rate.

faq.q: Can you move me from Chapel Hill to Raleigh or Durham?
faq.a: Yes. Moves between Triangle cities are local moves handled by our Triangle crews.

faq.q: I'm leaving North Carolina after graduation. Can you help?
faq.a: Yes. Moves out of state are long distance moves, quoted at a flat rate and carried on our own truck.

faqClosing: Want more detail on booking? Check the FAQ page for billing, deposits and the day itself.

closing.h2: Set Up Your Chapel Hill Move
closing.body: Send your lease dates and both addresses, and tell us if storage is needed. We'll price the whole stretch at once.
